quickAnswerTitle: Quick Answer: Do Untuckit Shirts Run Small?
quickAnswer: Yes. UNTUCKit says its men's shirts run smaller than traditional shirt brands. If you are between sizes, the brand recommends ordering one size up. The right choice also depends on the fit: Regular is the classic cut, Slim is narrower through the body, Relaxed adds room, and Tall options add length to the body and sleeves. Check your chest, waist, and sleeve measurements against the current chart before ordering.
intro: UNTUCKit is designed around shirts that look intentional when worn untucked, but choosing the right size still matters. The brand's own guidance is clear: men's shirts run smaller than traditional brands, and shoppers between sizes should order one size up. Below, we explain the available fits, show the published men's button-down measurements, and outline how to choose without relying on a generic size label.

sections.heading: Do UNTUCKit Shirts Run Small? The Short Answer
paragraphs: Yes. According to UNTUCKit's official men's size guidance, its button-down shirts run smaller than traditional shirt brands. The brand specifically advises customers who fall between sizes to order one size up.

That advice applies to men's shirts; do not assume that your usual size in another brand will fit exactly the same. Compare body measurements with the chart for the product category you are buying, because button-downs, dress shirts, polos, and other tops can use different charts.
A practical starting point: measure your chest and waist, check the sleeve range, then choose the fit that matches how much room you want through the torso.

bullets.label: Usually between sizes
bullets.text: Follow UNTUCKit's advice and order the larger size.

bullets.label: Prefer a closer silhouette
bullets.text: Compare the Slim fit chart rather than automatically sizing down.

bullets.label: Want more room
bullets.text: Look at Relaxed fit, which adds room through the body.

sections.heading: Understand the Five Men's Shirt Fits
paragraphs: UNTUCKit lists five fit options for men's button-down shirts. The fit changes the shape and proportions of the shirt, so choosing between Regular and Slim is not the same as choosing between two size labels.

bullets.label: Regular
bullets.text: The classic cut. UNTUCKit describes it as slightly smaller than traditional shirt brands.

bullets.label: Slim
bullets.text: A narrower cut through the torso with less fabric than Regular. Check the product's own fit details because the exact specification can vary by style.

bullets.label: Relaxed
bullets.text: Adds three inches of room in the body without adding extra length.

bullets.label: Tall Regular
bullets.text: Adds two inches to the body and sleeve length for taller customers.

bullets.label: Tall Slim
bullets.text: A slimmer shape with additional body and sleeve length.

sections.heading: How to Use the UNTUCKit Men's Button-Down Size Chart
paragraphs: The chart below reproduces the published body-measurement ranges for the Regular-fit men's button-down shirt. Measurements are in inches. Use the chart for the specific product category you are buying; UNTUCKit's dress-shirt, polo, and other size charts are not interchangeable.

If your measurements sit near the upper end of a range or between two sizes, take the brand's one-size-up guidance into account. Also check the sleeve range before ordering, especially if you usually need longer sleeves.

sections.heading: Regular, Slim, or Relaxed: Which Fit Should You Choose?
paragraphs: Choose Regular if you want the brand's classic silhouette. Choose Slim only if you prefer a closer shape through the torso and your measurements fit its chart. Choose Relaxed if you want more room through the body but do not want extra shirt length.

If your chest measurement points to one size but your waist or preferred ease points to another, avoid guessing from your usual T-shirt size. Use the current product chart and consider contacting UNTUCKit before purchase.

sections.heading: What If You Are Between Sizes?
paragraphs: UNTUCKit's published advice is to order one size up when you are between sizes. This is the safest starting point when comparing its men's shirts with traditional brands.

Do not size up automatically if your measurements already fall comfortably inside a size range. Instead, compare the chart and the fit description for the exact shirt. A Relaxed fit may provide the extra room you want without changing the size.

sections.heading: How Long Are UNTUCKit Shirts?
paragraphs: UNTUCKit designs its button-downs with an untucked length, but there is no single length measurement that applies to every shirt, size, and fit. Tall versions add length to the body and sleeves, while product styles can differ.

For the most reliable answer, check the measurements or fit notes on the individual product page. A good untucked hem should look intentional with your proportions; do not rely on a universal inch measurement copied from another style.

sections.heading: Are UNTUCKit Shirts Worth It If You Need a Specific Fit?
paragraphs: The main advantage is the choice of purpose-built fits: Regular, Slim, Relaxed, and Tall variations. That range can help shoppers who want a shirt designed to be worn untucked rather than simply leaving a conventional dress shirt untucked.

The trade-off is that you should check the brand's measurements carefully. Its own guidance says men's shirts run smaller than traditional brands, so ordering your usual size without checking the chart can be a poor shortcut.

sections.heading: Before You Order: A Quick Sizing Checklist
bullets: Measure your chest and waist in inches.
Check the size chart for the exact product category and fit.
If you are between sizes, follow the brand's recommendation to order one size up.
Compare sleeve length, especially if standard sleeves often feel short or long.
Choose Tall if you need additional body and sleeve length, not simply a larger torso size.
Review the product page's fit notes and return policy before buying.

paragraphs: Check the [official men's size charts](https://www.untuckit.com/pages/all-size-charts) for the latest measurements and other product categories. You can also review the brand's [fit guide](https://www.untuckit.com/pages/find-your-fit) to compare Regular, Slim, Relaxed, and Tall options.
Measurements and fit descriptions can change. The official chart for the exact item should take priority over a general guide.

faqs.question: Do UNTUCKit men's shirts run small?
faqs.answer: Yes. UNTUCKit says its men's shirts run smaller than traditional shirt brands. If you are between sizes, the brand recommends ordering one size up.

faqs.question: Should I size up in UNTUCKit shirts?
faqs.answer: If your measurements fall between two sizes, UNTUCKit recommends choosing the larger size. If your measurements fit comfortably within one size, compare the product's specific fit chart before deciding.

faqs.question: Is UNTUCKit Regular fit true to size?
faqs.answer: UNTUCKit describes Regular as its classic cut but says it runs slightly smaller than traditional shirt brands. Do not assume it fits exactly like the same size from another label.

faqs.question: What is the difference between UNTUCKit Regular and Slim?
faqs.answer: Regular is the classic cut. Slim has less room through the torso and a closer silhouette. Check the fit notes on the individual product because specifications can vary by style.

faqs.question: Is UNTUCKit Relaxed fit bigger?
faqs.answer: Yes. UNTUCKit says Relaxed adds three inches of room in the body without adding extra length.

faqs.question: What is UNTUCKit Tall fit?
faqs.answer: Tall Regular adds two inches to the body and sleeve length. Tall Slim combines a slimmer shape with extra length in the body and sleeves.

faqs.question: Are UNTUCKit size charts the same for every product?
faqs.answer: No. The brand publishes separate charts for categories such as button-down shirts, dress shirts, polos, and other tops. Use the chart for the exact product category.
